name: tracking-app
description: Tracking application backend for parcel monitoring and public tracking

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive: true}); ['styles.css','landing.css','admin.js','client.js','app.js','admin.html','client.html','login.html','index.html'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f));"
